description: A basic calculator - add, subtract, multiply, divide, percentages, squares, square roots. Fully offline.

name: Common Reading Pipeline
description: A generic reading pipeline: recognizes requests to read stories, articles, reports, horoscopes and more aloud, and routes them to whichever installed provider skill can supply that content. Not tied to any single content type or source.
examples: Tell me a story about cinderella
Read me an article about penguins
Tell me a story from grimm
Read me a horoscope about leo
author: andlo

description: Tells fairy tales by Hans Christian Andersen and the Brothers Grimm.

author: andlo

name: Geography
description: Geography facts - capitals, continents, borders, area, currency, and language for 194 UN member states. Fully offline.

what language do they speak in Egypt
author: andlo

name: Geography Practice
description: Geography practice - quizzes and teach-then-practice for capitals, continents, and country borders across 194 UN member states. Fully offline.

author: andlo

name: Geometry
description: Geometry knowledge - shape and term definitions, formulas, and applied calculations for rectangles, squares, triangles, circles, and the Pythagorean theorem. Fully offline.
examples: what is the formula for the area of a circle
what is the area of a rectangle with length 5 and width 3
what is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs 3 and 4
author: andlo

name: Geometry Practice
description: Geometry practice - quizzes and teach-then-practice for glossary terms, formulas, and Pythagoras' theorem. Fully offline.
examples: quiz me on area and perimeter
quiz me on what you taught me
author: andlo

name: Grimm Tales (provider)
description: Brothers Grimm fairy tales provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin. No standalone voice interface.
examples: Tell me a story from grimm
Tell me the story about cinderella
Can you tell me a fairy tale from the brothers grimm
author: andlo

name: Holidays
description: Public holidays, Easter, and calendar-date math. Fully offline, computed live via the holidays library.
examples: what day of the week is march 3rd
author: andlo

name: Horoscope Readings (provider)
description: Reads daily zodiac horoscopes aloud. Provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin - no standalone voice interface.
examples: Tell me a horoscope about leo
Read me a horoscope about taurus
author: andlo

name: Intercom
description: LAN intercom - send a spoken message to a named OVOS device on the same network. Speak-only, never executes commands on the receiving device.
examples: set intercom name to living room
set intercom code to four seven two nine
send a message to the bedroom
author: andlo

name: Math Practice
description: Math practice for kids - counting, times table recitation, and interactive quizzes across addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and percentages. Fully offline.
examples: quiz me on the 3 times table
give me a full math quiz
author: andlo

name: Metronome
description: A metronome - set a tempo in BPM and get an audible click track with an accented downbeat. Fully deterministic and offline: generated click tones, not recordings.
author: andlo

name: Morse Code
description: Encodes text to Morse code, played as generated audible beeps. Fully offline, nothing recorded.
examples: how do you say SOS in morse code
author: andlo

name: NATO Alphabet
description: Spells a word using the NATO/ICAO phonetic alphabet - Alfa, Bravo, Charlie. Fully offline, pure lookup table.
author: andlo

name: Network Scanner
description: Discovers devices on your own local network via mDNS/Bonjour plus a ping+ARP+MAC-vendor sweep. Fully offline, no root required.
examples: can you see my Sony TV
is my printer on the network
author: andlo

name: OVOS Blog (provider)
description: Reads the OpenVoiceOS blog aloud. Provider for ovos-common-reading-pipeline-plugin - no standalone voice interface.
examples: Read newest post from the openvoiceos blog
author: andlo

name: Rhythm Box
description: A simple drum-machine skill - loops a beat pattern (rock, four-on-the-floor) at a chosen tempo. Fully offline, generated drum sounds.
examples: play a rock beat at 100 bpm
author: andlo

name: Sound Like
description: How does a cow sound? Bundled offline sounds (currently animals) for instant answers, with an optional freesound.org online fallback for anything else, filtered to CC0-licensed results.
examples: what does a dog sound like
author: andlo

name: Tuning Fork
description: A reference-tone generator - give me an A plays 440Hz, play 300 hertz plays any frequency. Fully offline, generated tones, nothing recorded.
author: andlo

name: Unit Converter
description: Local, offline unit conversion - no cloud dependency, no API key. Covers length, mass, temperature, time, speed, area, volume, angle, density, pressure, force, energy, power, torque, acceleration, concentration, computer, and flow.
author: andlo

name: Voices of Tomorrow
description: Plays pre-recorded audio readings of 365tomorrows.com flash fiction stories, via OCP. Separate from ovos-skill-365tomorrows-stories, which reads the text aloud via TTS instead.
author: andlo

name: White Noise
description: An ambient noise machine - white, pink, and brown noise for sleep or focus. Fully offline, all generated, nothing recorded.
author: andlo

name: Wiki Offline
description: Offline general-knowledge lookup covering Wikipedia's ~10,000 Level 4 Vital Articles. English, Spanish, and French are native; any other language is answered via on-demand offline translation. No internet connection needed.
examples: tell me about the Eiffel Tower
author: andlo
